free_tier_limits.correction: Business-email signups receive a 30-day trial; ongoing free API keys are restricted to qualifying, verified public-interest work.

rate_limits.correction: Trial and paid keys have per-calendar-month quotas; exceeding the assigned quota returns HTTP 429. The key-specific quota appears in the API console and can be raised by support.

notes: The hosted API and documented search endpoint remain live. The material errors are the claimed unknown free-access limits and unpublished rate limits: eligibility, trial duration, monthly quotas, and HTTP 429 behavior are documented. The search example is mechanically valid, although OpenSanctions recommends /match—not /search—for screening. No authoritative CORS policy was found.
